items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: I would like, if I could have played like that.

ctx.x: In fact I was a little small boy at that time. I mean you say that you like René and people like that, and Kukku. But was your style of trumpet playing, did it sound anything like those guys at all, or was it a totally different sound?

Well I tell you, René was a clean-cut trumpet player. He played a lot, he played a lot, he played a lot, he played quite a bit. But he had a pretty nice, clean way of playing, and I would like, if I could have played like that.
But you weren't playing too much like that, I mean you didn't sort of sound like that.
